metadata.title: K-contact manifolds admitting some geometric solitons with Semi-Symmetric Non-Metric Connection
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we introduce some type vector fields with respect to a semi-symmetric non-metric (SSNM) connection. We investigate several geometric properties of a K-contact manifold equipped with an SSNM connection and provide a concrete example to justify the relation between the scalar curvature of the SSNM connection and Levi-Civita connection that we have obtained in this paper. Furthermore, we have found the nature of Riemann solitons, conformal Ricci solitons and conformal $\eta$-Ricci-Yamabe solitons on K-contact manifolds admitting a SSNM connection.\\ Finally, we determine the necessary and sufficient conditions for such a manifold to be $\Tilde{\tau}$-semi-symmetric, quasi-conformal-semi-symmetric and pseudo-projective-semi-symmetric.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 在带半对称非度量联络的 K-contact 流形上研究若干孤立子、曲率对称条件和模型例子。
techniques: 特殊联络的曲率恒等式
Riemann 与 Ricci–Yamabe 型孤立子方程
analysis.breakthrough: 在指定联络背景下推导标量曲率和几何向量场间的关系。
analysis.limitations: 联络并非通常 Levi-Civita 联络，不能把这些公式直接当作标准 Ricci 流结论。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 研究对象与曲率下界及度量测度空间主线距离较远，主要是专门联络中的关系式，故后置而非作质量判断。
